scale_cues: Square white plate about 25–26 cm wide; the pear is about 9 × 8 cm across. Individual almonds (about 2.2 cm long, 1.2 g each) and grapes (about 2 cm across, 4–5 g each) were counted and checked against the plate size.
assumptions: I counted about 37 almonds at about 1.2 g each.
I counted about 20 grapes at about 4.5–5 g each; some may be hidden under others.
The pear weight is its whole weight, including skin. The core and stem (about 8–10% of the weight) are usually not eaten.
The almonds look raw. Dry-roasted almonds would have similar macros.
There is no added oil, dressing or drink.
